files.name: dochi_mapicon_integration-0.1.0-forge-1.20.1.jar
files.html:
Dochi's MapIcon Integration 0.1.0

  • Added NPC map icons for Xaero's Minimap and World Map.
  • Added defaults by applied JSON type and individual NPC icon settings.
  • Added bundled/custom PNG icons, size controls, and a full RGB color picker.
  • Added icon visibility, map selection, and name display controls.

Requires Dochi RPG Maker and its dependencies. Xaero map mods are optional. Currently supports Xaero's Minimap and World Map. JourneyMap support is planned for a future update.
